user.title: TorrentManager — connect to C411
user.description: Generate an API key on the “Intégrations API” page of your C411 account ({integrations_url}).

qbittorrent.title: qBittorrent server
qbittorrent.description: qBittorrent Web UI address (Tools → Options → Web UI).

reauth_confirm.title: Update credentials
reauth_confirm.description: C411 or qBittorrent rejected the stored credentials.

error.invalid_qb_auth: Invalid qBittorrent credentials (or IP banned after too many failures).
error.cannot_connect_qb: Cannot reach qBittorrent. Check the URL and that the Web UI is enabled.

data.feed_categories: Categories watched for new releases (empty = all)
data.qb_category: Default qBittorrent category (when none is set for the type)
data.qb_save_path: Default save path (when none is set for the type)

folders.title: Folders per type
folders.description: Where qBittorrent stores each content type, e.g. `/data/movies`, `/data/tv`. Paths as seen by qBittorrent. Leave empty to use the default folder.

plex.title: Plex connection
plex.description: Server address, e.g. `http://192.168.1.20:32400`. To find the token: in Plex Web open an episode → ⋯ → “Get Info” → “View XML”; the token is the `X-Plex-Token` value in the URL. Clear the address to disconnect Plex. The same token is also used for posters and recommendations.

data.plex_refresh_on_complete: Rescan Plex when a C411 download completes

series.title: TV show tracking
series.description: For each Plex show, the integration looks on C411 for episodes and seasons after the latest one in Plex. A notification is sent for each new season found.

data.series_follow_new: Automatically follow shows added to Plex
data.series_packs: Accept full-season packs (seasons missing from Plex)
data.series_next_seasons: Catch up on all missing later seasons (otherwise: current and next season only)
data.series_notify_service: Also send notifications to this service (e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone)

display.title: Display and access
display.description: Posters and recommendations come from the Plex catalogue, using the token from “Plex connection”. A TMDB key is only useful without Plex, or as a complement.

data.best_only: Show only the best version of each title (default)
data.pref_quality: Preferred quality for picking the best version
data.pref_language: Preferred language for picking the best version
data.tmdb_api_key: TMDB API key (optional, not needed with Plex)

abort.plex_required: Set up the Plex connection first.

search.name: Search C411
search.description: Search C411 and return the results.

download.name: Download with qBittorrent
download.description: Fetch the .torrent from C411 and send it to qBittorrent.

title.name: Title
title.description: Used for the file name and the event.

type.name: Content type
type.description: movies, series, anime, music, books, games, software, other

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Refresh C411 new releases and qBittorrent status.

check_series.name: Check TV shows
check_series.description: Looks on C411 for new episodes of followed Plex shows (and downloads them when automatic mode is on).
